standing.title: Political standing
standing.turnExplainer: 1 turn = 1 real hour. 48 turns = 1 game year. Cap: {cap}.
standing.hoardWarning: Above {threshold} actions, a hoarding penalty of {penalty}/turn applies.
standing.influenceTooltip: Political foothold in home state. Spend actions to grow it; it decays each turn. Higher influence improves odds in state elections and unlocks local power.
standing.nationalTooltip: Standing on the national stage. Grows passively each turn based on state influence. The note shows your rank in the country and the leader's score.
standing.favorabilityTooltip: Public approval rating. Stable at 60% or below unless attacks, infamy, or other hostile effects push it down. Above 60%, it naturally cools back toward that floor.
standing.infamyTooltip: Negative reputation from hostile actions. Above 20%, it reduces your favorability each turn. Keep it low to maintain voter appeal.
standing.partyInfluenceTooltip: Standing within the party. Accumulates each turn based on policy alignment, leadership roles, and infamy.
standing.partyBonusEarning: Currently earning +{count, plural, one {# bonus action} other {# bonus actions}} per turn (max {max}).
standing.partyShare: {share}% of the party's total influence pool.

finances.title: Finances
finances.subtitle: Campaign resources and personal wealth, kept separate from political standing.
finances.donorTooltip: Fundraising tier. Spend money via Actions to level it up. Each level permanently increases hourly income. The cap scales with the home state's population.
finances.tapHourlyBreakdown: Tap to see hourly income breakdown.
finances.clickHourlyBreakdown: Click to see hourly income breakdown.
finances.campaignTooltip: Campaign war chest used for elections, political actions, and donor upgrades. Cannot be used for personal expenses.
finances.personalTooltip: Personal cash on hand, separate from campaign funds. CEO salary and bond coupon income are paid here.

interact.title: Interact
interact.supportTitleMediaCap: This candidate's Media Spending is sustaining their favorability at the cap. Wait for them to reduce media spend or for their campaign to end.
interact.supportTitleMaxed: Their favorability is at 100%. Wait for it to decay before supporting again.
